description: This file defines the 'Bigint' class in the 'ZipStream' namespace, which provides methods for handling 64-bit integer operations, including initialization, addition, and byte manipulations, primarily for ZIP archive processing.

classes.name: Bigint
classes.description: A class that encapsulates 64-bit integer operations using byte arrays, including methods for initialization, addition, byte conversion, and comparison.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Bigint instance with an optional integer value.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Bigint from an integer value.

methods.name: fromLowHigh
methods.description: Creates a Bigint from low and high 32-bit integer parts.

methods.name: getHigh32
methods.description: Returns the high 32 bits of the Bigint.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the byte array spanning specified end and length.

methods.name: getLowFF
methods.description: Returns the low hexadecimal FF value as a float, optionally forcing the check for over 32.

methods.name: isOver32
methods.description: Checks if the value exceeds 32 bits, with an optional forced check.

methods.name: getLow32
methods.description: Returns the low 32 bits of the Bigint.

methods.name: getHex64
methods.description: Returns a hexadecimal string representation of the 64-bit value.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds another Bigint to this instance, returning a new Bigint, and throws an OverflowException if overflow occurs.

methods.name: fillBytes
methods.description: Protected method to fill the byte array with an integer value starting at a specified position.
